name: Bitdeer Technologies Group Class A Ordinary Shares
description: Bitdeer Technologies Group is principally engaged in the provision of digital asset mining services. The Company does not conduct any substantive operations on its own but conducts its primary operations through its subsidiaries. Its majority business segments are: proprietary mining, cloud hash rate sharing and cloud hosting. The company operates five proprietary mining datacenters in the United States and Norway, Bhutan and Singapore.
